message: Astra: Within this meeting, does changing Bob's “first goal” to “first target” change his voice, or merely his wording? What deserves closer attention if your aim is to make Bob and Alice distinguishable on the page? Why would more analysis be worth its time compared with attempting a short revision now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make waiting more useful? What evidence would settle that choice without requiring real database results? Which next step will you choose and carry out, and how will you check whether it changes what a reader hears?
